newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares start off cautiously, outlook unsure.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares start off cautiously, outlook unsure.

text.p: Danish share prices opened slightly lower on Monday, with dealers in cautious mood and unsure about whether or how long the market could go on rising at home and in the United States.
"The mood is wary and a little jittery. We should not see any major activity today," one dealer said.
Novoi Nordisk, its first nine-month 1996 result due on Wednesday, was expected to attract attention.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 0.03 point to 127.43 at 0815 gmt, having closed a marginal 0.02 point higher on Friday.
